topic: DIMSTYLE R2007+ linetype references, cross-implementation evidence, and bounded local closure

sources.name: ODA Open Design Specification for DWG files, DIMSTYLE section 20.4.68
sources.evidence: For R2007+, DIMSTYLE handle stream fields 345 dimltype, 346 dimltex1, and 347 dimltex2 are hard pointers.
sources.limit: Authoritative DWG binary layout evidence; not DXF tag spelling or native rendering qualification.

sources.name: Autodesk ObjectARX Managed Reference: DimStyleTableRecord linetype properties
sources.evidence: All three are read/write ObjectId properties for dimension and extension-line linetypes.
sources.limit: Object model evidence; public Autodesk DXF DIMSTYLE table still omits codes 345-347.

sources.name: ezdxf DIMSTYLE internals, API, and implementation
sources.evidence: Documents 345-347 as R2007+ LTYPE handle references, provides name-facing APIs, and implements name-to-handle/resource resolution. It labels the fields unofficial and absent from Autodesk's DXF reference.
sources.limit: Independent implementation evidence, not normative authority or AutoCAD acceptance; exact source/version must be pinned for future differential use.

sources.name: LibreDWG source model snapshot
sources.evidence: The inspected DWG DIMSTYLE structure includes DIMLTYPE, DIMLTEX1, and DIMLTEX2 as BITCODE_H fields.
sources.limit: Source model only; inspected URL is a mirror/fork, and no converter execution or round-trip was performed.

sources.name: Autodesk public DIMSTYLE DXF reference
sources.evidence: Lists modern table reference codes 340-344 but omits 345-347.
sources.limit: Omission is retained as a producer acceptance caveat.

sources.name: ezdxf pre-R2007 per-DIMENSION linetype override documentation
sources.evidence: Describes undocumented ACAD_DSTYLE XDATA keys 380-382 with 1005 LTYPE handles for entity-level linetype overrides.
sources.limit: Separate from table codes 345-347; schedule only after versioned producer evidence establishes exact XDATA framing and null/default semantics.

local_review.confirmed_gap: DRW_Dimstyle stores and parses 345-347 handles, and the DWG path carries these fields for AC1021+. The strict full-conversion DXF writer resolves 340 and 341-344 but does not yet close source LTYPE identity for 345-347; generic variable emission can pass these through without remapping to emitted output handles.
local_review.classification: One local PAR-23/7J graph-closure gap; not proof of consumer rejection or overall support status.

sequence: Add transactional source-LTYPE identity mapping (source handle, normalized name, emitted handle), including fixed BYBLOCK/BYLAYER/CONTINUOUS targets.
Resolve strict modern full-conversion 345-347 references by identity; require name/handle consistency and distinguish explicit null from absent.

Extend the existing generated ASCII/Binary dimension_picture_block_full_conversion control for custom/builtin linetypes, remap, forward ordering, version gates, missing/mismatched references, rollback, and following-record integrity.
Run focused adapter build and owning CTest only; defer full suite and external consumers to composed gates.
Keep 380-382 plus XDATA 1005 as a separate deferred compatibility investigation pending producer evidence.
implementation_readiness.fixtures: No committed test drawings. Generate controls locally from scratch in temporary test paths.
